EmailTemplate.subject: Interested in minoring in music at ASU?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in minoring in music at the Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts School of Music at ASU. As one of the largest universities in the country, the ASU School of Music awards over $2 million to students annually, providing an excellent education at an unbeatable value. ASU's diverse and innovative community is a perfect complement to the personal attention you will receive in the School of Music. With a population of around 750 students, we offer small class sizes, state-of-the-art facilities and one-on-one instruction from world-renowned faculty. We invite you to consider the ASU School of Music for this important step in your music studies. Music Minors
We offer two music minors which are also available as BIS concentrations.
Music Performance Minor
Includes private instruction in one instrument Requires an audition
Music Studies Minor
Academic and does not include instrumental instruction Does not require an audition
How to add a Music Performance Minor:
Step 1: Contact MusicAdmissions@asu.edu and indicate your major instrument when you are ready to audition. We will give you the contact information of a faculty member who you can contact to set up an audition.
Step 2: Contact a faculty member to set up an audition. Prepare the non-performance audition requirements for undergraduates. If you aren't sure what to prepare, ask the faculty member.
Step 3: If you pass the audition, the School of Music will send an email saying that you are admitted to the Music Performance minor. Make an appointment with your major area advisor and bring the email with you. How to Add a Music Studies Minor:
Step 1: Consult with your major area advisor to add the minor. We welcome you to contact us via email to MusicAdmissions@asu.edu if you have any additional questions. We also encourage you to refer to the School of Music website, music.asu.edu, as a resource for your admissions questions.
Best Wishes,
Office of Admissions School of Music
Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts Arizona State University
